text:
Which statement describes the process of cracking?
A
It is the breakdown of a compound using electricity.
B
It is the breakdown of long chain hydrocarbons.
C
It is the combination of many small monomers.
D
It is the separation of a mixture of hydrocarbons.

options.label: A
options.text: It is the breakdown of a compound using electricity.

options.label: B
options.text: It is the breakdown of long chain hydrocarbons.

options.label: C
options.text: It is the combination of many small monomers.

options.label: D
options.text: It is the separation of a mixture of hydrocarbons.
